from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEmployeeCashPayment(BaseModel):
    """Financial metric record extracted from one company's report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact line item label in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the metric")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit, e.g., 'CNY' or '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this data")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[CompanyEmployeeCashPayment]
